title: Build unambiguous test dates 1
scenario: A fictitious test schedule stores year, month and day as separate integers. All listed dates are valid, including a leap-day case. All records and limits are fictitious training assumptions.

lesson.intro: DATE builds an Excel date from numeric components without ambiguous text parsing. TEXT formats that date for an ISO-style output. For date arithmetic keep the DATE result numeric; this task deliberately requests an ISO text label.

formulas.name: DATE
formulas.explanation: year, month and day are numeric components. DATE produces a numeric date serial.

formulas.name: TEXT
formulas.explanation: value is the number or date to format. format_text controls the returned text.

task.prompt: Construct each date from Year, Month and Day, then return ISO text yyyy-mm-dd. Use all 20 rows in source order, without deduplication. Inputs have no blanks or zeros and are valid dates; do not infer dates from identifiers. Enter at B2 and fill down through B21. No rounding applies. Return 20 rows × 1 column, without a header, in Answers!B2:B21. Use an Excel formula; any equivalent approach is accepted. Submit the formula and the complete output.

columns.name: Day
columns.description: Valid numeric day for the listed month/year.
